usernames.title: Profiles
usernames.description: Instagram usernames or profile URLs. Each returns a profile row plus its latest posts with views, likes and comments.

postUrls.title: Post or Reel URLs
postUrls.description: Optional. Direct links like https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/ to get one post's numbers.

fileUrls.title: Extra file URLs
fileUrls.description: Optional public file links (logos, reference images) to save in the key-value store as FILE_1, FILE_2... in 190 KB parts.

maxPostsPerProfile.title: Max posts per profile
maxPostsPerProfile.description: Latest posts to read per profile (up to 12; 0 = profile counts only). Each post costs one extra page load.

includeProfileRow.title: Add one profile summary row per account
includeProfileRow.description: Adds a row with type 'profile' (followers, post count, bio) next to the post rows.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Instagram blocks shared datacenter IPs. Residential works (tested Nov 2026) and costs about $0.03 per profile.

saveImages.title: Save post images
saveImages.description: Stores every image (all carousel slides) in the key-value store as IMG_<shortcode>(_n), in 190 KB parts (<key>.p0, .p1...).

saveVideos.title: Save post videos
saveVideos.description: Stores each Reel or carousel video in the key-value store as VID_<shortcode>(_n), in 190 KB parts.

debugProbe.title: Probe page formats (debug)
debugProbe.description: Fetches profile, embed and post pages for the first profile and saves a short report (PROBE) instead of scraping.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a blocked request with a new IP.

debugSaveHtml.title: Save raw profile pages (debug)
debugSaveHtml.description: Stores each fetched profile page in the key-value store.
